title: Flaming Hot Cheetos
lyrics:
[00:17.29]Sometimes I feel like I just wanna go back to my old ways
[00:21.83]You're tellin' me I'm silly, it's no fun in the old days
[00:25.99]I'm such a romantic, I never remember how things really happen
[00:30.91]I guess you're attractive or something
[00:34.88]Live in the moment, that's what they tell me
[00:38.04]But whatever happened to when you would hold me, and hold me, and hold me?
[00:43.56]Girlfriend or girl that's a friend, it's easy just to pretend
[00:47.84]That we don't want something real, it's just how we feel
[00:55.63]We feel, oh, it's just how we feel
[01:04.34]How we feel
[01:09.77]I'm feeling something right, I'm feeling something right
[01:14.22]I'm feeling something right, I'm feeling something right
[01:18.58]I'm feeling something right, I'm feeling something right
[01:27.21]I wanna be the one you think about at night
[01:31.28]And I wanna be the one that you would put up a fight for
[01:36.39]You know that I adore, that even when you're bored
[01:40.59]I'd buy you anything and everything I can't afford
